changes: Lift passengers no longer enter airborne gravity when a different client commands downward or reverse travel
The lift carries both the robot transform and Rapier body before running character physics and maintains grounded support while aboard
Remote lift start packets wait for the rider-aware transport tick; remote y corrections cannot fight the active cabin
Robots can still jump or walk out of the cabin, releasing the support attachment
Lift starts, stops and arrivals now use a server-authorized event and persistent motion timeline instead of frequent position snapshots
Lift clients animate the same height, floor readout, landing buttons, shaft and collision position without jumping on scene revisions
Robot riders are predicted locally and owner pose updates include lift elevation; scene persistence remains ownership-checked
Robot control switcher is draggable with 25% larger portraits, active-selection highlight and scene-to-control synchronization
Add paired portal Entry and Exit, each movable independently in the realm
True doorway frames with static piecewise colliders, colour, texture and opacity
Automatic or button-triggered portal teleport with bounded delay, scene mouse and WebXR controls
Robot/object and XR/free-camera transport, physics sync, loop cooldown, Web Audio chime and portal glow
Reduce z-fighting on adjacent procedural stairs, roof/wall panels and overlays
Add opt-in floor-call stations beside the landing exit at every level of a procedural lift, with compact red numbered buttons and configurable left/right placement.
Keep landing-call stations stationary while the lift cabin moves, with an orange requested-floor indication and green arrived-floor indication.
Support mouse clicks and WebXR controller-ray selection using the existing permission-checked lift movement and saved destination action.
Expose Call button at each level and Button side inside the compact Lift stops and cabin settings; preserve existing lifts with calls disabled by default.
Validate and persist the call-button configuration, accept earlier five-field lift settings, and add focused source/runtime regression tests.
Add two small in-world lift control columns (inside and outside cabin) with numbered switches for each configured level.
Use green idle, red requested destination, and orange passing-floor feedback, plus a continuously updated large floor digit inside the cabin.
Allow ordinary pointer clicking and WebXR controller-ray selection, routing both through owner/permission-checked lift transport and scene persistence.
Play quiet synthetic Web Audio start and arrival jingles after an activated button press; no external audio downloads.
Update only controls/display textures and colours during lift movement; preserve riders, existing kinematic collision and lift settings.
Fix lift rider movement crash from plain {x,y,z} delta incorrectly treated as THREE.Vector3; keep owned robot kinematic bodies aligned during ascent and return.
Update lift kinematic platform body position with each moved frame to keep collision state aligned with rendered cabin.
Provide missing square.svg used by geometry icons to eliminate 404s.
Associate administrator and Tripo password fields with forms and add accessible admin username hints.
Add executable lift rider regression tests for moving up/down, dynamic objects, malformed deltas and source wiring.
Add Stairs advanced to Office Space with compact collapsible railing, rods/posts, roof/tunnel, supporting posts, step material and texture controls.
Add Escalators and Moving walkways with configurable speed/direction and contact-based movement of locally owned robots and loose dynamic objects, using separate geometric treads and physics.
Add Lifts with an open-ended cabin, two through twelve levels, floor-height/width controls, level landing frames and Start/Stop commands for kinematic travel.
Persist/validate new parametric settings, lift destination/current height, undo/redo snapshots and scene/archive metadata; avoid unnecessary collider rebuilds from travel-only state updates.
Add eight focused geometry, transport math, backend wiring and persistence regressions and bound test-runner concurrency for reliable watcher validation.
Robot portrait selector remains visible above Camera Follow, with correct active-robot highlighting. Selecting a robot now activates arrow-key control independently of Properties selection.
Video recording from chat or My Camera opens a live preview; capture does not begin until the user presses Start. Pause, resume, stop, discard, chat, scene and surface sharing remain available.
Chat audio and video attachments use slim shared custom controls, time/seek/mute/fullscreen, compact download/delete actions and no raw filename or native player bar.

Chat fetches metadata instead of loading entire recordings. On Play, authenticated 15-minute HLS access is requested; native HLS or locally bundled hls.js plays the stream; direct blob playback is a failure fallback.
Media deletion requires uploader/admin authorization and rejects scene, environment, profile and bookmarked references; linked chat attachments are unlinked on success.
Realm transitions: defer replacing the old scene until the next realm data arrives, reject stale responses and build objects in frame-sized batches
World Settings: avoid redundant floor-texture reapplication, physics resets and scene-list rebuilds when no setting changed
Chat: render the latest 180 entries initially, progressively load older history, yield frames during long timelines and retain full transcript exports
Chat controls: center the downward navigation arrow and enlarge participant avatars by 50 percent
Robot Control: replace the visible dropdown with selectable robot portrait/initial buttons above the controller
My Camera: Record, Pause/Resume and Stop buttons reuse the active webcam video; recorded clips can be attached to chat, added to the scene or drawn onto a selected cube/plane as a media frame

Virtual view capture: optional canvas captureStream recording with MediaRecorder on supported browsers, with a 15 fps capture target and conservative video bitrate; not guaranteed to include Quest passthrough
Media frames: choose realm chat attachments, camera-bookmark screenshots, uploaded media, live webcam photos or a recorded webcam clip
Chat composer: show a live webcam preview during video recording and recorded video playback after stopping
Procedural walls: convert individual wall segments to static editable cubes with true O-key cuttable openings and trimesh colliders
New robot messages: progressive typing and a subtle bubble entrance animation (history and reduced-motion users unaffected)
Compact chat audio play/seek/mute UI; signed expiring HLS VOD access for audio and video on native-HLS browsers; authenticated blob fallback elsewhere
Freeze camera during drawing and correct pointer-to-world ray mapping
Use analytic cube face raycast for openings and media rectangles (including pre-cut cubes)
Editable and persistent text geometry: content, font, size, extrusion and bevel with local typeface assets
Add regression tests for text geometry validation and camera lock
Capture O/U and freehand pointer drags on a full-view transparent drawing layer so SOLVI HUDs cannot intercept the gesture; keep the camera locked until the tool ends.
Replace the large surface popup and unnecessary Confirm button with a passive compact instruction hint. Drag directly, release to preview, press Enter to keep, or Escape/click elsewhere to discard.
Show a filled translucent rectangle and bright border during opening and media drags; show the real cut-through cube immediately on release before saving, with restoration on cancel.
Ensure media frame stays visible after release until Enter opens realm chat attachments; add interaction tests for preview, commit and unsaved cancellation.
Replace click-by-click curve placement with continuous pointer-drag drawing projected onto a locked screen-facing, XZ floor, XY, or YZ plane. Orbit is disabled only while drawing.
Add Fill end caps checkbox to extruded/beveled curves; persist and validate capEnds for saved and imported curves.

Repair O cube openings: true through-hole geometry previews immediately after the drag, Enter / Confirm persists the cutout and exact static trimesh; Escape or canvas click restores the original mesh without saving.
Repair U face media mounting: confirm frame rectangle before choosing authenticated realm chat media, and persist the mount with the first object save rather than in a later racing update.
Add seven tiny deterministic procedural textures to World Settings floor: concrete, soil, tarmac, sand, tiles, gradient tiles, and random tiles. Respect floor colour and room-scoped environment save.
Add regression tests for stroke projection and sampling, open curve caps, floor style normalization and geometry preview/media persistence.
Synchronize selection in Objects with a clearly highlighted inverted-color row and aria-current.
Add editable spatial 3D curves with per-point depth/elevation placement, control points, offset, extrusion thickness, rounded bevel, bevel resolution and path resolution; persist and clone in realms.
Add O to draw rectangular through-openings on cube faces. Build a true cutout mesh with internal tunnel surfaces, maintain undo/redo and static trimesh collision matching the opening.
Add U to draw media rectangles on cube and plane surfaces, with a searchable authenticated room-chat attachment browser for images, audio and video. Mounted frames follow source geometry transforms.
Validate all new curve/opening/mount payloads in both Flask scene routes; preserve mounted-media links and remap scene target IDs during realm archive imports.
Integrate new modules with versioned browser imports and add geometry, persistence and security regression tests.
Repair chat attachment observer/cache ReferenceError; correct admin chat clear request exact-name, invalidate cleared room and prevent pre-clear transcript replay.
Lock airborne robot heading and horizontal velocity from takeoff until physics confirms landing, including remote prediction; shift into Run after two seconds of continuous forward input.
Move Chase Smart angle threshold control into selected Robot Properties and switch Chase/Chase Smart to Orbit Follow on intentional camera drag.
Add S/M/L responsive grid size switchers to Avatar and Asset galleries, persisted per-browser.
Replace primitive geometry steppers with a single property selector, numeric value and shared live range slider; unify inspector styling.
Emit once-per-missing-clip diagnostic for avatar actions to local Brain debug events; add regression tests for chat, gallery, air-motion and controls.
Make Robot routines a persistent-position draggable SOLVI floating panel with accessible scrollable controls on desktop and mobile.

Use application-native accessible dialogs rather than browser confirm/prompt across robot discussions, realm/scene deletion, chat clear, avatars, assets, bookmarks, profile logout, theme reset and diagnostics.
Make Shift+ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the free camera vertically only, without simultaneous forward/backward travel; preserve PageUp/PageDown vertical movement.

Fix admin chat clearing races: invalidate all in-flight older message requests and cached media/portrait callbacks, remove transient traces/presence entries for the cleared realm, and ignore stale responses after room switches.
Add regression coverage for camera axes, draggable routines, native-dialog replacement, async message invalidation and attachment cleanup.
Add Camera: Chase Smart with a user-adjustable heading threshold (5–120°, default 35°); a small turn leaves the camera heading steady, a substantial turn triggers smooth inertial follow.
Keep World Tools on screen as a draggable minimized title bar by default, with one-click restore, saved location and prior minimize state.
Remember the last accessible realm per profile across refreshes; update the selected realm title immediately and reject stale scene loads after fast realm switches.
Avoid blocking first scene render on chat history; deduplicate authenticated portrait and attachment downloads and lazy-load only chat media near the visible viewport.

Give globally unlocked administrators full-room chat export (not just the latest 80), followed by exact-realm-name confirmed chat clearing; server enforces admin session and room scope, keeps scene assets and other realms, and notifies connected clients.
Move application-wide Administrator login, active status, dashboard and Lock Admin into the signed-in Profile drawer; remove duplicate inline password entry from Avatar Edit.

Share a short-lived server-verified administrator session across authenticated API requests and protected WebSocket robot events, Realms, Avatar/Asset libraries, AI settings, diagnostics and scene ownership checks.
Add server-side POST /api/admin/logout to revoke the temporary administrator token without signing out the ordinary profile; keep admin tokens in tab memory only and expire after the server window.
Refresh editor and gallery permission controls when administrator access changes, while maintaining all server-side protection and permanent-delete confirmations.
Include extensive LLM_HANDOVER.md covering SOLVI architecture, operations, history, deployment/test failures, security, UX/physics priorities and future context transfer.
Fix Flask integration test after legitimate avatar-deletion scene revision increments; isolate realm revision assertions.
Keep server-side avatar fallback migrations and cross-realm revision updates without resetting saved history.
Preserve permanent avatar deletion, realm cloning, complete archive imports, and all v0.2.93 features.
Replace per-realm repeated Rename and Delete controls with one selected-realm toolbar, including Clone, Rename and protected Delete.
Clone rooms in the SQLite backend using unique copy names and shared immutable model/media references; retain environment and ownership permissions.
Correct full realm archive import GLB model and speaker URL remapping to restored model UUIDs, and refuse damaged, incomplete or unsupported files instead of silently omitting scene objects.
Validate export asset inventories and missing server files; report precise failures before creating an incomplete imported realm.
Make avatar deletion results and permission errors visible at the top of the gallery, with inline Admin unlock for server-bundled avatars.
Delete requested avatars independently after one confirmation, preserving any referenced files and clearly listing why each refused item was retained.
Fix shared API error handling so generic HTTP 409 conflict does not incorrectly force account reauthentication.
Permanently delete selected bundled avatars from the Ubuntu server and public catalog with explicit administrator authorization, not browser-only hiding.
Protect avatars still used in any realm or profile, and preserve the default SOLVI fallback avatar; owners can still remove unused uploads.
Persist bundled-avatar deletion tombstones and reapply them after future static-file deployments so removed models do not reappear.
Repair Asset library overlapping cards with a fixed responsive portrait grid and pages of 12 items, keeping selection and export operations.
Add backend integration and frontend regression tests for destructive deletion permissions, redeployment persistence, and gallery layout.
Give Avatar and Asset libraries an accessible Edit mode, per-card multi-selection checkboxes, Select all, ZIP export and confirmed bulk removal.
Add avatar search and display accurate GLB animation-action counts from metadata for uploaded and bundled models whenever files are available.
Let users hide bundled release avatars locally while keeping shared baseline model files intact; allow only upload owners and administrators to delete custom assets.
Prevent deletion of model and avatar files referenced in any realm, and provide authenticated ZIP downloads containing selected models and library metadata.
Display portrait-style Asset thumbnails matching the Avatar gallery, without redundant decorative icons covering preview images.
Prevent walking/running animation stumbles by maintaining the authored gait loop across brief physics-controller/network stalls; return to Idle when genuinely stopped.
Add library authentication, export, deletion, scene-reference and gait tests.
Fix native walk/run clip cadence and smooth small Rapier stair autosteps so avatars no longer visibly hop at an ordinary step.
Offer independently persisted Walk animation, Run animation and Jump animation speed multipliers (0.35–2.0×) in the existing one-slider robot inspector.
Select Jumping for stationary jumps and Jump for jumps with movement; match exact authored avatar clips and fall back to Jump when Jumping is absent.
Keep the airborne jump pose synchronized to expected physics flight; select Landing or Hard Landing based on drop height and use the final phase of Jump when an avatar lacks a Landing clip.
Validate animation controls in both atomic and bulk Flask scene writes, and add JS/Flask regression coverage for clip selection, speed, visual step easing and persistence.
Fix Uniform Scale editing: scale X/Y/Z geometry and inspector fields update together while typing or dragging the contextual range slider, with a single edit commit on change.
Clarify physics modes in object Properties, including a permission-checked Make pushable control that sets an object to Dynamic and keeps static scenery unchanged.
Improve Punch/Kick target contact against imported meshes by testing the nearest collider surface in front of the striking limb and verifying strike height instead of testing distant model pivots.
Apply Dynamic-object combat impulses at the physical contact point when supported by Rapier, including rotational response, with authority retained by the object owner.
Report when a local punch or kick does not find a movable target and add functional tests for contact detection and Dynamic-only impulse application.
Isolate running and walking animation per robot identity: an idle robot cannot inherit a nearby robot’s stale Run/Walk state or movement packets.
Permit a pushed robot to play temporary backward, forward, or lateral steps only while a measured, physically applied displacement is current; return to Idle after contact.
Require close, approaching capsule contact at a comparable floor height before automatic robot-to-robot pushing, rather than broad model proximity.
Accept compact multiplayer robot-impact events only when attacker and victim remain within realistic push/strike reach; only the target owner applies displacement.
Add five regression tests for independent animations, contact approach, stale modes, per-robot multiplayer packet scope, and impact validation.
Keep physics jumps airborne through ascent and descent, increase launch velocity, and release the Jump animation only after a real landing rather than a transient grounded contact.
Recognize distinct Falling, Falling Idle, Falling To Landing, Falling Flat Impact, and Stand Up animation states with real default-avatar fallback clips for lower and severe drops.
Use authored Running and backwards-walking clips before synthetic walking fallbacks; normalize one-shot hit/landing durations to prevent partial held poses.
Apply Punch and Kick impacts during the clip strike phase, replay short Head Hit/Hit to Body/Wobbling reactions, and permit stronger hits to transition through death-like fall and recovery.
Relay compact, permission-checked robot-impact events for cross-owner robot collisions and attacks, and let Rapier character colliders integrate the victim displacement.
Increase compact live movement input frequency and merge incoming scene revisions in place without destroying remote avatar mixers or rewinding currently predicted positions.
Add eight regression tests for physics jump height, falling/landing animation clip resolution, combat impulse timing, network pose preservation, contact events, and recovery.
Prevent static walls, floors and stair trimeshes from triggering a Push animation: contact now requires a nearby movable dynamic body or actual robot-to-robot displacement.
Animate only after Rapier resolves movement so walking cadence follows current-frame displacement; prevent slow in-place limping when blocked by fixed scenery.
Keep Jump animation active until the character controller records actual airborne movement and subsequent landing, regardless of keyboard movement or stair autostep.
Give Punch/Kick/Throw one-shot Mixamo clip playback with clipped intro/outro, action-length scaling and a once-only mid-clip Rapier impulse instead of a key-down impact.
Drive pushed robot forward, backward or lateral step animations from actual capsule displacement with frame-limited motion; preserve remote action packets and owner-simulated dynamic bodies.
Use collider world bounds rather than pivot distance for combat hits on spheres and furniture; keep physics impulses limited to movable bodies.
Add six executable animation lifecycle tests and retain existing movement and backend route regression coverage.
Fix the Flask scene-object POST route mistakenly registered on valid_robot_combat(settings), which returned 500 on any atomic object save.
Register /api/scene/object on patch_scene_object() and retain the combat validator as an undecorated utility.
Add Flask integration checks for route registration, valid robot combat persistence and invalid settings in both atomic and bulk scene writes.
Preserve v0.2.83 robot footsteps, push, combat, impulses, multiplayer actions and platform gravity without changing their behavior.
Undo/redo Office Space construction and property changes using Control/Command+Z and Shift+Control/Command+Z.
Fix the wall panel responsive clipping and allow native select/color controls without cutting off options.
Show 1.70 m human silhouette and adjustable 2.5 m ceiling-height visual guide during wall placement.
Update wall color live during picker input and offer wireframe-only or live material plus wireframe previews.
Closed room vector tool draws a floor polygon outline and creates a closed wall perimeter with adjustable height.
Stair generator follows single/multiline/freehand floor paths, with even step counts or fixed tread/riser mm dimensions, optional free-floating treads and individual physics colliders.
Persist and validate stair geometry and closed room settings in scene object API; support scene archive metadata.
Add functional regression tests for stair flight metrics, geometry persistence, keyboard history and editor widgets.
Correct Office Walls edit lifecycle: live in-place geometry, Save commits original-vs-current state, Cancel restores original without a duplicate wall mesh.
Add a floor pointer cursor, live cyan wireframe wall volume and segment path that tracks the pointer before the next click, including multiline previews.
Default grid snapping with selectable 0.25–2.0 m steps; snap single/multi wall segments to 15/30/45/90-degree increments or free angles.
Compact draggable wall controls using numeric width/height/opacity fields and one context-sensitive slider, responsive on mobile.
Freehand smoothing button and adjustable smoothing strength using curve-preserving corner rounding, plus optional automatic freehand smoothing on create.
Allow PNG/JPEG/WebP wall texture upload via authenticated scene media, persist image metadata across reloads and include/remap referenced images in realm archives.
Add regression tests for wall snapping, freehand smoothing, editor in-place updates, cancellation, server validation and custom-image persistence.
